assumptions: Nashville International Airport (BNA) is the single airport returned for both the airport name and the code BNA, in Nashville, Tennessee.
The comparison uses calendar 2024 and calendar 2025, and same calendar month versus the prior year. Fiscal-year and trailing-twelve-month windows were not used.
limitations: Seats offered are departing passenger and combi capacity. Enplanements, seat factor, terminal capacity, unmet demand, fares, and profitability are not measured here and are not established.

The result pools all carriers and all destinations. No carrier, international, or route split is included.

T-100 departing-seat coverage in the catalog runs from January 2024 through July 2026, so both calendar years in this comparison are complete. This is a capacity trend, not a screening rank and not a valuation.
